name: Advanced Quest Generation - Dynamic Quest Creation with AI

parameters.jsCode:
// Format quest data for Google Sheets storage
const questData = $input.first().json;
const { enhancedQuest } = questData;

// Prepare row data in the correct order for Google Sheets
const rowData = [
  enhancedQuest.id,
  enhancedQuest.name,
  enhancedQuest.description,
  enhancedQuest.type,
  enhancedQuest.category,
  enhancedQuest.difficulty,
  enhancedQuest.recommendedLevel,
  enhancedQuest.estimatedDuration,
  enhancedQuest.status,
  enhancedQuest.giver,
  enhancedQuest.giverLocation,
  enhancedQuest.questLocation,
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.objectives),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.rewards),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.prerequisites),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.consequences),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.branching),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.state),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.discovery),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.relationships),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.scaling),
  enhancedQuest.importance,
  enhancedQuest.urgency,
  enhancedQuest.createdAt,
  enhancedQuest.generatedBy,
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.tags),
  JSON.stringify(enhancedQuest.analytics)
];

return {
  json: {
    range: 'Quests!A:Z',
    values: [rowData]
  }
};

parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  success: true,
  quest: {
    id: $json.enhancedQuest.id,
    name: $json.enhancedQuest.name,
    type: $json.enhancedQuest.type,
    difficulty: $json.enhancedQuest.difficulty,
    estimatedDuration: $json.enhancedQuest.estimatedDuration,
    giver: $json.enhancedQuest.giver,
    location: $json.enhancedQuest.questLocation,
    importance: $json.enhancedQuest.importance,
    urgency: $json.enhancedQuest.urgency,
    objectives: $json.enhancedQuest.objectives.length,
    rewards: $json.enhancedQuest.rewards,
    tags: $json.enhancedQuest.tags,
    createdAt: $json.enhancedQuest.createdAt,
    generatedBy: $json.enhancedQuest.generatedBy
  },
  analytics: $json.enhancedQuest.analytics,
  contextualData: {
    partyLevel: $json.contextualData.partyAnalysis.level,
    partySize: $json.contextualData.partyAnalysis.size,
    calculatedDifficulty: $json.contextualData.calculatedDifficulty
  }
} }}
